text: {"claims":[{"cid":"c1","text":"A randomised call centre experiment found a 13 percent rise in completed calls among remote staff.","cited_pids":["remote_work#0"]},{"cid":"c2","text":"The call centre productivity gain was attributed to a quieter environment and fewer breaks.","cited_pids":["remote_work#0"]},{"cid":"c3","text":"Output per engineer measured by completed tickets held steady or improved after full transitions to distributed work in several large technology firms.","cited_pids":["remote_work#3"]},{"cid":"c4","text":"A large field experiment found remote data entry workers were 18 percent less productive than office counterparts on identical tasks.","cited_pids":["remote_work#6"]},{"cid":"c5","text":"Communication becomes more siloed after a remote transition, with slower information flow.","cited_pids":["remote_work#5"]},{"cid":"c6","text":"Software teams show weaker onboarding and mentoring after going remote, which can depress output over time.","cited_pids":["remote_work#4"]},{"cid":"c7","text":"Self-reported productivity gains from remote work often fail to appear in objective measures.","cited_pids":["remote_work#7"]},{"cid":"c8","text":"Remote workers gain usable hours from eliminated commuting.","cited_pids":["remote_work#1"]},{"cid":"c9","text":"Lower attrition under flexible work policies may reduce productivity losses from rehiring.","cited_pids":["remote_work#2"]},{"cid":"c10","text":"The effect of remote work on productivity appears to depend on the task and role.","cited_pids":[]}]}
